clips.text: That was enough: the cross became a throne and death a new life.
In the moment of revolution between one statement and the next Christ descended into Jesus.
Your suffering is intense and a new birth is at hand; be happy, be grateful.
Don't be afraid of death, be thankful It is the tidings of a new birth.
And the old must die to give birth to the new; the seed must break to blossom into the flower.
